The image displays a grid of sequential panels containing hand-drawn illustrations in a gritty, underground comix style. Visible elements include characters in dynamic poses (one holding a gun), speech bubbles with text, caption boxes, and varied panel borders. The paper appears aged or textured, not highly glossy.
